map.随机分组器，输入名单一键按组数或每组人数随机分组，辅助活动分队与抽签。: The random grouping tool takes a list and splits it in one click by group count or by group size, supporting team assignment and draws.
map.名单先洗牌（Fisher–Yates）后顺序切分；按组数分组时每组人数 = ⌊N: The list is shuffled first (Fisher–Yates) and then split in order; when grouping by group count, each group holds ⌊N/G⌋ people and the remainder N mod G is spread over the first few groups (e.g. 22 people into 4 groups gives 6/6/5/5); when grouping by group size, the number of groups is ⌈N/M⌉ and the last group holds N − M×(groups−1) people
map.先洗牌再切分保证每个成员落入任意组的概率相同，避免\"按输入顺序轮流分配\"造成: Shuffling first and then splitting gives every member an equal chance of landing in any group, avoiding the systematic bias of round-robin allocation in input order. When the head count does not divide evenly, the remainder is spread out (rather than dumped into the last group) so group sizes differ by at most 1, which suits competitive events. The shuffle uses the browser's pseudorandom generator without a seed, so the same list gives a different, non-reproducible result each time; for draws that need an audit trail, export the result before running. Grouping quality constraints (gender/grade balance, mutually exclusive members) require manual stratification first, then separate grouping.

map.排班与轮值：按人数与班次生成轮值表初稿。: Shift scheduling and rotation: generate a draft rotation roster from head count and shifts.
